nginx.description: Web server or reverse proxy: nginx, with the certificate client as an extra.
notes: Installing nginx does not configure it: sites, certificates and the service state are not managed by package actions.
apt and dnf install the nginx branch the distribution ships (it follows the OS release); no vendor repository is added.

postgresql.description: PostgreSQL database server, with contrib modules and client headers as extras.
notes: apt and dnf install the major version the distribution ships (it follows the OS release); only brew pins a major here.
On dnf the cluster must be initialised (postgresql-setup --initdb) before the service can start; package actions do not do that.
brew formulae are versioned (postgresql@17); a newer major version is a different package.
